findings: Slow-server banner suppressed after first successful server load — when the user switches from a server that loaded (iframeLoaded===true) to a new one, the iframeLoaded watcher effect may read the stale true value from the previous render and call setSlowServer(false) immediately, cancelling the 15s timer before the banner can appear. Fix: remove the separate watcher effect and call setSlowServer(false) directly inside the onLoad handler.
